environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) deployed in EKS cluster namespace 'webhooks-prod' behind an API Gateway HTTP API with no request validation. The Lambda is invoked via a VPC Link from an internal NLB. CloudWatch Logs Insights queries are used by the SOC team for alerting, with metric filters parsing structured log lines for anomaly detection. No input sanitization middleware is configured on the API Gateway route. The function is accessible from any pod in the cluster via the internal NLB endpoint at webhooks-nlb.webhooks-prod.svc.cluster.local:443.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API with no request validation templates
config.network: VPC Link to internal NLB, no IP restrictions
config.logging: CloudWatch Logs with metric filters parsing log lines
config.mesh: Istio sidecar injected but permissive mode (PERMISSIVE mTLS)
